methods.name: Mask R-CNN model incorporating physical mechanism–optical–morphological features
methods.summary: An instance segmentation approach that uses Mask R-CNN with a ResNet-50 backbone and FPN, enhanced by stacking multi-source data (spectral, textural, morphological, and physical landslide-influencing factors) as input layers and applying a 90-degree rotation for data augmentation.
methods.verbatim: This paper aims to perform remote sensing interpretation through combining the masked R-CNN algorithm model with the constraints of spectral, structural, morphological and physical features of landslides in remote sensing imagery.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory used for training and validation is not referenced or linked. The custom Mask R-CNN code is not available via any repository or persistent link.
